title: Lifted-current continuity makes the temporal-gauge normal form a residual-gauge boundary cocycle

gauge_cocycle.density: For psi_n=Q^n phi define rho_n=e Im<Q psi_n,D_t psi_n> and j_n^a=e Im<Q psi_n,D^a psi_n>
gauge_cocycle.continuity: The real scalar potential and commuting charge imply partial_t rho_n+div j_n=0 for every smooth cutoff solution
gauge_cocycle.residual_gauge: Under a smooth periodic time-independent residual temporal-gauge transformation A maps to A+grad chi and psi_n maps by the matching charge phase, while rho_n and j_n are gauge invariant
gauge_cocycle.boundary_cocycle: On the closed torus M_n=int A dot j_n changes by int grad chi dot j_n=d/dt int chi rho_n; hence K1558's correction carries an exact time-boundary cocycle rather than instantaneous gauge invariance
gauge_cocycle.consequence: A coercive instantaneous estimate must fix the residual gauge or include a compatible charge-boundary convention; the identity points toward a spacetime/nonlocal completion rather than silently treating M_n as gauge invariant
gauge_cocycle.scope_guard: The cocycle classification is on the smooth periodic core and does not cover large non-single-valued gauge transformations or spatial boundary flux; it does not control int A dot partial_t j_n, prove coercivity, select a global gauge, pass to the completed domain or complete the PDE flow
